title: Sandbox Boundary Definitions
body:

Scope and schema. The scope of this record is exactly one well defined piece of tool safety: sandbox boundary definitions. Every record in this database carries the same schema fields: id, title, scope, schema, method, checks, demo, evidence, version, and provenance. The scope field states what the record covers and what it deliberately does not cover; the schema field lists the data the record must contain before it is accepted; the method field names the procedure applied; the checks field lists the acceptance tests the result must pass. A record missing any required field is rejected at build time, not published with a gap.

Method. The working method for this record is Sandbox boundary and permission policy design. First, the question is written down in one sentence so its scope is clear. Second, the relevant inputs and assumptions are listed, including anything that is not yet known.
